key.name: popup-keybinding
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens the Clipway clipboard history popup. Handled by the Clipway GNOME Shell extension.

key.name: incognito
key.description: When true, new clipboard content is neither captured nor stored.

key.name: excluded-apps
key.description: App IDs (as in the .desktop file name) or window classes. Nothing copied while one of these apps is focused is recorded. Matching is case-insensitive and ignores a trailing ".desktop".

key.name: history-depth
key.description: Maximum number of unpinned entries kept. Pinned entries are never evicted and do not count toward this limit.

key.name: max-text-bytes
key.description: Clipboard text larger than this many bytes is not read or stored.

key.name: max-image-bytes
key.description: Clipboard images larger than this many bytes are not read or stored.

key.name: clear-on-logout
key.summary: Clear history when the session ends
key.description: Remove unpinned history when you log out or restart. Applied when Clipway next starts in a new session, so it also covers crashes and power loss. Pinned entries are kept.

key.name: sync-primary
key.description: Also record text you select (the middle-click paste buffer), and set it when restoring text entries.
